tldr_en: LangSmith Preview Builds provide per-pull-request temporary deployments for testing agent changes before production, with setup, testing, validation, and automatic teardown.
takeaways_en: Preview builds create temporary LangSmith deployments for each GitHub pull request.
Test LangChain agents locally with langgraph dev before deploying.
Validate the deployed branch in LangSmith Studio, with each commit triggering a new preview revision.
Merging the pull request automatically tears down the preview deployment.
implication_en: This tool reduces risk when iterating on autonomous agents, enabling safer experimentation with 'reality-code manipulators' without breaking production systems.

translations.title_zh: LangSmith 预览构建：在生产前测试智能体变更
translations.tldr_zh: LangSmith 预览构建为每个拉取请求提供临时部署，用于在生产前测试智能体变更，包含设置、测试、验证和自动拆除。
takeaways_zh: 预览构建为每个 GitHub 拉取请求创建临时 LangSmith 部署。
使用 langgraph dev 在本地测试 LangChain 智能体。
在 LangSmith Studio 中验证已部署分支，每次提交触发新的预览修订版。
合并拉取请求会自动拆除预览部署。
translations.implication_zh: 该工具降低了迭代自主智能体的风险，使实践者能够在不破坏生产系统的情况下，更安全地试验“现实代码操纵者”。

tldr_en: Hamel Husain and Marek Galovic explain how late interaction multi-vector retrieval scales to billions of documents and why it outperforms single-vector search for AI agents.
takeaways_en: Single-vector search fails agents because it compresses entire documents into one summary, losing token-level specificity for diverse queries.
Late interaction keeps one embedding per token and enables precise matching, but naive implementation costs 100x storage and 1000x compute.
Pruning billions of candidate documents down to a few hundred before exact scoring makes multi-vector retrieval practical.
A 100M multi-vector model outperformed an 8B dense model at 42% accuracy for a thirteenth of the cost.
Separating storage from reads/writes and tuning the right parameters are key to making retrieval work on your own data.
implication_en: Practitioner-philosophers building agents should adopt token-level retrieval as a foundational infrastructure choice, because an agent's ability to act on reality depends on retrieving the right symbolic fragments from a sea of precomputed vectors.

translations.title_zh: 多向量检索如何在大规模下工作
translations.tldr_zh: Hamel Husain 和 Marek Galovic 解释了后期交互多向量检索如何扩展到数十亿文档，以及为何它在 AI 智能体场景下优于单向量搜索。
takeaways_zh: 单向量搜索会失败，因为它把整个文档压缩成一个摘要向量，丢失了面向多样化查询的令牌级特异性。
后期交互为每个令牌保留一个嵌入，实现精确匹配，但朴素实现需要 100 倍存储和 1000 倍计算。
在精确评分之前将数十亿候选文档剪枝到几百个，使多向量检索变得实用。
一个 1 亿参数的多向量模型以十三分之一的成本，在 42% 准确率上超越了 80 亿参数的稠密模型。
将存储与读写分离并调优正确参数，是让检索适配你自己数据的关键。
translations.implication_zh: 构建智能体的实践型哲学家应将令牌级检索作为基础架构选择，因为智能体对现实采取行动的能力取决于从海量预计算向量中检索到正确的符号片段。

tldr_en: Latent Space maps how every component of AI training—reward signal, data, teacher, curriculum, researcher, environment, and even human subjects—is being replaced by synthetic/model-generated counterparts, arguing that 'simulation' is now the central engine of frontier AI progress.
takeaways_en: From 2022 onward, each part of the ML pipeline has flipped from human-made to model-made, starting with reward models and now reaching environments and simulated humans.
Synthetic environments like Z.ai GLM-5.3 synthesize tasks, judges, and verifiers end-to-end, making RL scale without human-built worlds.
Karpathy’s 2026 autoresearch loop shows coding agents can run real ML experiments and stack improvements autonomously.
Simulation of human subjects (Simile, digital twins, SimGym) is becoming an inference workload for user studies and A/B tests.
The physical world remains experiment-bound, but efforts like virtual cells aim to make the last bottleneck another simulation layer.
implication_en: For a practitioner-philosopher, this is concrete evidence that the boundary between 'real' and 'simulated' is dissolving in the very infrastructure of AI, making simulation not a thought experiment but an engineering substrate that increasingly steers agents, markets, and scientific discovery.

translations.title_zh: [AINews] 差10%、便宜100倍、快10000倍：为何模拟正在接管一切
translations.tldr_zh: Latent Space 梳理了AI训练流程中的每个环节——奖励信号、数据、老师、课程、研究者、环境乃至人类被试——如何被合成/模型生成的版本取代，认为“模拟”已成为前沿AI进展的核心引擎。
takeaways_zh: 自2022年起，机器学习流程的每一部分都在从人造翻转为模型造，先是奖励模型，现在已扩展到环境和模拟人类。
像Z.ai GLM-5.3这样的合成环境实现了任务、裁判和验证器的端到端合成，使强化学习无需人工构建世界即可扩展。
Karpathy 2026年的自动研究循环显示，编码智能体可以自主运行真实的机器学习实验并叠加改进。
人类被试的模拟（Simile、数字孪生、SimGym）正在成为用户研究和A/B测试的推理负载。
物理世界仍是实验瓶颈，但虚拟细胞等努力旨在让最后的瓶颈也变成另一个模拟层。
translations.implication_zh: 对于实践型哲学家而言，这是具体证据：真实与模拟之间的界限正在AI的基础设施中溶解，模拟不再只是思想实验，而是日益引导智能体、市场和科学发现的工程基底。

tldr_en: Joon Sung Park discusses Simile AI's approach to scaling human-behavior simulation from generative agents to digital twins, aiming to simulate populations for decision-making and exploring whether we live in a simulation.
takeaways_en: Generative agents evolved into Simile's foundation models of human behavior, reaching 85% accuracy vs humans reproducing their own responses.
Useful simulations must reproduce human biases and causal mechanisms, not just rational LLM outputs; prompting frontier models isn't enough.
Simulation scales beyond prediction to shaping the future, with population-level and individual-level models and post-training on interviews, transactions, and RCTs.
Long-term vision: simulate all 8 billion people requiring data-center-scale worlds; market research is just the first commercial use case.
The interview links simulation to psychohistory, societal problems, and whether we already live in a simulation.
implication_en: This episode reframes agent simulation as a scaling law and practical steering mechanism, forcing a rethink of how market-influenced AI models become reality-manipulation tools for both commerce and civilization.

translations.title_zh: 模拟：新的规模法则 — Joon Sung Park, Simile AI
translations.tldr_zh: Joon Sung Park 讨论了 Simile AI 将人类行为模拟从生成式智能体扩展到数字孪生、并用于群体决策模拟以及探讨我们是否生活在模拟中的方法。
takeaways_zh: 生成式智能体已演变为 Simile 的人类行为基础模型，在复现人类自身反应的准确率上达到 85%。
有用的模拟必须复现人类偏见和因果机制，而不只是理性大语言模型的输出；仅靠提示前沿模型是不够的。
模拟从预测扩展到塑造未来，包括群体级和个体级模型，并基于访谈、交易数据和随机对照试验进行后训练。
长期愿景是模拟地球上全部 80 亿人，这需要数据中心级别的世界；市场研究只是第一个商业用例。
访谈将模拟与心理史学、社会问题以及我们是否已生活在模拟中联系起来。
translations.implication_zh: 本期节目将智能体模拟重构为一种缩放定律和实用的操控机制，促使实践型哲学家重新思考市场驱动的 AI 模型如何成为商业与文明的现实操控工具。

tldr_en: Brain Researcher is an agentic neuroimaging research harness that enforces methodological rules, required checks, and claim-scope constraints, boosting first-choice tool selection from 23.3% to 93.6% and verifiable grounding from 4.6% to 22.0% while using multiverse analyses to expose analytic-choice sensitivity.
takeaways_en: Brain Researcher wraps LLM agents with admissible-analysis rules, required checks, and claim scoping, raising tool-selection accuracy from 23.3% to 93.6%.
Verifiable grounding improved from 4.6% to 22.0%, still low and revealing reliability gaps in agentic scientific claims.
Multiverse analyses exposed how analytic choices change conclusions, shifting claims from premature success to qualified, revised, or blocked.
Embedding methodological judgment in the workflow—not post-hoc—links decisions to evidence and provenance, making claims defensible.
implication_en: For practitioner-philosophers steering AI as reality-code manipulators, this shows that constraining agent workflows with explicit epistemic rules and provenance transforms raw tool-use into defensible, evidence-bound claims—a step toward trustworthy autonomous inquiry.

translations.title_zh: 为科学智能体引入分析严谨性：用于神经影像数据分析的 Brain Researcher 平台
translations.tldr_zh: Brain Researcher 是一个智能体神经影像研究框架，通过强制执行方法规则、必需检查和声明范围约束，将首选工具选择准确率从 23.3% 提升到 93.6%，可验证依据从 4.6% 提升到 22.0%，同时利用多宇宙分析揭示分析选择敏感性。
takeaways_zh: Brain Researcher 用可允许分析规则、必需检查和声明范围约束包装 LLM 智能体，将工具选择准确率从 23.3% 提升到 93.6%。
可验证依据从 4.6% 提升到 22.0%，虽仍较低，凸显了智能体科学声明的可靠性差距。
多宇宙分析揭示了分析选择如何改变结论，将声明从过早宣称成功转变为合格、修订或被阻止。
在工作流中嵌入方法论判断（而非事后）将决策与证据和溯源联系起来，使声明可辩护。
translations.implication_zh: 对于将 AI 作为现实代码操纵者来驾驭的实践哲学家而言，这表明用明确的认知规则和溯源约束智能体工作流，能将原始工具使用转化为有依据、有证据边界的声明——迈向可信自主探究的一步。

tldr_en: The paper shows that static-profile LLM agents over-essentialize demographic identities, and proposes LifeMem, a longitudinal memory framework combining life-event retrieval and parametric memory, which improves human-like diversity and change patterns in social simulations.
takeaways_en: Static demographic profiles cause identity essentialism: agents compress within-group variation and exaggerate between-group differences.
LifeMem adds structured retrieval of life events plus agent-specific parametric memory to integrate experience over time.
Across three LLMs and two panel datasets, LifeMem better matches human response distributions, within-group diversity, and within-person change.
Longitudinal memory helps agents evolve dynamically rather than remain fixed to group stereotypes.
Implications for building faithful social simulations: avoid relying on prompt-only memory and sparse static profiles.
implication_en: For a practitioner-philosopher, this highlights that to create believable simulated agents, you must embed time and personal history; otherwise you get caricatures, undermining any simulation's epistemic value.

translations.title_zh: 利用纵向生命轨迹缓解LLM智能体中的身份本质主义
translations.tldr_zh: 该论文表明，静态画像的LLM智能体会过度本质化人口身份，并提出LifeMem这一纵向记忆框架，结合生活事件检索和参数记忆，改善社会模拟中的人类多样性与变化模式。
takeaways_zh: 静态人口画像导致身份本质主义：智能体压缩组内差异并夸大组间差异。
LifeMem加入结构化生活事件检索和智能体专属参数记忆，以持续整合经验。
在三个LLM和两个面板数据集上，LifeMem更好地匹配了人类响应分布、组内多样性和个人内部变化。
纵向记忆帮助智能体动态演化，而非固定于群体刻板印象。
构建可信社会模拟的启示：避免仅依赖提示记忆和稀疏静态画像。
translations.implication_zh: 对实践哲学家而言，这凸显了要创建可信的模拟智能体，必须嵌入时间和个人历史，否则只能得到滑稽模仿，削弱任何模拟的认识价值。

tldr_en: Toyota uses LangChain and LangSmith to build manufacturing AI agents like GearPal that let technicians diagnose and fix machines, with observability likened to Toyota's Andon board and already delivering six-figure per-line annual savings.
takeaways_en: GearPal lets any technician query a broken machine for diagnosis and repair steps, built on LangChain.
LangSmith's observability dashboard serves as Toyota's Andon board for AI agents, enabling production-line-style monitoring.
Toyota stopped building its own agent infrastructure to focus on domain-specific agent development.
These agents are already delivering six figures in savings per line per year, with seven to eight figures projected.
LangChain/LangSmith are credited in Enterprise AI's balance sheet, indicating strategic ROI accountability.
implication_en: For practitioners building or steering autonomous agents, this illustrates how enterprise observability and a clear ROI framing can turn LLM agents from experiments into production assets, though it remains vendor-specific rather than a fundamental advance in simulation theory.

translations.title_zh: 丰田制造AI内部：LangChain、LangSmith与六位数投资回报率
translations.tldr_zh: 丰田使用LangChain和LangSmith构建制造AI代理，如GearPal，让技术人员诊断并修复机器，其可观测性被比作丰田的安灯板，且已实现每条生产线每年六位数的节省。
takeaways_zh: GearPal让任何技术人员都能询问故障机器的问题和修复步骤，基于LangChain构建。
LangSmith的可观测性仪表板充当丰田AI代理的安灯板，实现生产线式监控。
丰田停止自建代理基础设施，以便专注于领域特定的代理开发。
这些代理已实现每条生产线每年六位数的节省，预计可达七到八位数。
LangChain/LangSmith被记入企业AI的资产负债表，表明战略性的ROI问责。
translations.implication_zh: 对于构建或管理自主代理的实践者，这展示了企业级可观测性和明确的ROI框架如何将LLM代理从实验转变为生产资产，尽管它仍属于供应商特定方案，而非对模拟理论的根本推进。

tldr_en: Classical world models with finite memory inevitably misalign with even classical reality on some trajectories, but a quantum world model using a single qutrit can reproduce the true world exactly, preserving optimal agent policies.
takeaways_en: Finite classical world models cannot always align optimal policies with true worlds, even when the true world is classical.
The failure is irreducible: classical models either confuse action preferences or assign highest reward to suboptimal actions, with non-vanishing reward estimate error.
For each such true world, a quantum world model using one qutrit can reproduce it exactly, achieving perfect policy alignment.
This suggests quantum resources may be necessary for high-fidelity world simulation in some environments, challenging classical-only simulation assumptions.
implication_en: Practitioners building simulation-trained agents must recognize that classical simulators have fundamental fidelity limits, and that quantum models—while not yet practical—point to a new axis of simulation capability relevant to both AI alignment and the computability of reality.

translations.title_zh: 世界模型与现实对齐中不可约的量子优势
translations.tldr_zh: 即使真实世界是经典的，有限记忆的经典世界模型也会在某些轨迹上不可避免地与现实失配，而使用单个量子三态系统的量子世界模型能够精确复现真实世界，从而保持最优智能体策略一致。
takeaways_zh: 有限的经典世界模型并非总能对齐真实世界中的最优策略，即使真实世界本身是经典的。
这种失败不可消除：经典模型要么混淆动作偏好，要么持续给次优动作最高期望奖励，且奖励估计误差不可消失。
对于每个这样的真实世界，使用单个量子三态系统的量子世界模型可以精确复现，实现完美策略对齐。
这表明某些环境中高保真世界模拟可能需要量子资源，挑战了仅依赖经典模拟的假设。
translations.implication_zh: 构建基于模拟训练的智能体的实践者必须认识到经典模拟器存在根本保真度限制，量子模型虽不实用却指向了新的模拟能力维度，与AI对齐和现实可计算性密切相关。
